name: generate_image
description: Generate Sunburst stills synchronously; paid image approval applies, estimated cost unknown.

prompt.description: Nonblank image instruction, at most 32000 characters.

size.description: 1K, 2K, auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Defaults to 2K. Edges divisible by 16, <=3840; aspect 1:3 to 3:1; 655360 to 8294400 pixels. Above 2560x1440 is experimental.

model.description: Sunburst alias or 2026-09-08 snapshot. Other configured IDs are UNVERIFIED and dry-run only.

quality.description: One of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, auto.

n.description: Number of output images, integer 1 to 10. Defaults to 1.

output_compression.description: Optional integer 0 to 100, only with jpeg/webp output.

name: edit_image
description: Edit a primary image with up to 15 references and an optional mask; no polling required.

prompt.description: Nonblank image instruction, at most 32000 characters.

image_path_or_url.description: Primary image to edit. HTTPS, base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP data URL, immutable asset handle or local path under RENDERHAUS_MEDIA_DIR.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to 15 additional image references for character/product consistency, in order after the primary image. Same input types as image_path_or_url; 16 inputs total.

mask_path_or_url.description: Optional alpha mask for the first image. Same image reference types. Match source format and dimensions; transparent regions guide edits. Provider validates remote masks.

size.description: 1K, 2K, auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Defaults to 2K. Edges divisible by 16, <=3840; aspect 1:3 to 3:1; 655360 to 8294400 pixels. Above 2560x1440 is experimental.

model.description: Sunburst alias or 2026-09-08 snapshot. Other configured IDs are UNVERIFIED and dry-run only.

quality.description: One of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, auto.

n.description: Number of output images, integer 1 to 10. Defaults to 1.

output_compression.description: Optional integer 0 to 100, only with jpeg/webp output.
